description: This file defines the ReviewService class which provides methods to gather review scope information, including uncommitted changes and branch differences, for use in a code review UI and agent.

classes.name: ReviewService
classes.description: Provides review scope information for the UI and lightweight summaries for the agent to start reviews.

methods.name: getScopeInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about available review scopes, including uncommitted changes and branch differences.

methods.name: getReviewSummary
methods.description: Provides a lightweight review summary for a specified scope ('uncommitted' or 'branch').

methods.name: getUncommittedSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary of uncommitted changes.

methods.name: getBranchSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary of branch differences.
